responseLandingTxt2: [W]The respondent must provide a response to the claim even if they believe that another respondent is liable.
responseLandingTxt3: [W]If a response is not provided, a judgment may be issued against the respondent without a hearing.
responseLandingTxt4: [W]If the respondent consider another person or company may be liable, they should still submit a response. The respondent can explain why they think someone else may be liable in the ‘Contesting the claim’ section.
